lines.t: Everyday, I get up troubles new, but everyday I look to you and say.
Help me lord with all my troubles, help lift off these burdens,
help me be made new again in you.
when I take a wrong turn you guide me back,
every time I fall, you lift me back up,
everyday, every season, I see your mercy always there for me.
thank you lord for all you do, thank you lord for making me new.
